ValidationRule.description: PW Order Scheduled date must be current or future date. It cannot be in the Past. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (RecordType_Name__c = "CLAS - RM") && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Order_Scheduled_date__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Order_Scheduled_date__c)) && DATEVALUE(Order_Scheduled_date__c) < TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Order_Scheduled_date__c)) || DATEVALUE(Order_Scheduled_date__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Order_Scheduled_date__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Order_Scheduled_date__c)) && DATEVALUE(Order_Scheduled_date__c) < TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: PW Order Scheduled date must be current or future date. It cannot be in the Past.
